objects.family: On the unit torus, answer I at every point queried by a deterministic finite adaptive procedure; compare A0=I with A1=2I except on the finite queried set, where A1=I.
objects.failed_claim: Finitely many adaptive point values alone certify arbitrary measurable effective conductivity to operator error less than 1/2.
objects.scope: All deterministic finite point-query procedures under this access model. It is not a lower bound against L1 names, integral data, a supplied regularity modulus, random sampling, or unrestricted algorithms.
objects.continuous_variant: Replace the point modifications by smooth dips supported in a union of balls of total volume v<1/100, taking value I at the queried points and 2I outside. The effective tensor is at least 2/(1+v) I by the harmonic lower bound. No common continuity modulus is supplied.

objects.family: For circuit C on n explicit bits, d=n+1 and A_C(x)=(1+C(1_[x_2>=1/2],...,1_[x_(n+1)>=1/2])) I_d.
objects.exact_solution: For mean e_1, E=e_1 and B=A_C e_1; div B=0.
objects.proved_implication: A deterministic algorithm polynomial in circuit length and precision bits that approximates this energy within 2^(-n-2) computes #SAT exactly by rounding and implies P=NP.
objects.scope: Conditional counting-hardness for succinct coefficients with variable explicit dimension. No P!=NP claim, no lower bound for an already expanded table, and no resolution of unrestricted QUBO.
